verseText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
meaning: Even when we experience tough times of trouble in life, we don't need to be afraid. God has promised to be with us.

recall.question: Why does the writer say, “I will fear no evil”?
choices: God promises that he'll never have problems
He is strong enough to fight his own battles

meaning.question: A shepherd uses a rod and staff to protect and guide his sheep. What does this picture teach us about God?
choices: He will guide us and keep us safe
He wants us to carry around a staff
He will smack us with a rod

application.prompt: Even in the darkest times, God is with you like a shepherd caring for His sheep. Think of something that makes you afraid. How could remembering God's promise to be with you help you face your fear?
